symptom: `mxcli check -p` passed statements the write then refused part-way through exec ("this Mendix 9.24.30 project cannot store Microflows$RestOperationCallAction (Mendix 10.1.0+)"; "… DatabaseConnector$DatabaseConnection.ConnectionInput (Mendix 10.0.0+)"; on 10.24.24 "… Microflows$TransformJsonAction (Mendix 11.4.0+)"): send rest request, range, call external action, transform … with, find/filter … where, and on the sweep loops, show page arguments, queued calls, database queries and connections, workflow parameters and user tasks, page variables, snippet parameters, navigation and REST client shapes; `create view entity` was gated at 10.18 and refused at write time on 10.18-10.20
cause: Gates were added statement by statement from memory of what was new; the write's floors (canon.UndeclaredTypeError for types, canon.StripUndeclaredProperties for a property holding a value) cover everything mxcli writes, so every written type or property newer than 9.0.0 without a gate at or above its floor is a check/exec disagreement. Several existing rows were typed by hand below the write's floor (view_entities 10.18 vs the 10.21 source document) or above it (execute_database_query 10.6, business_events 10.0)
file: `mdl/executor/version_gates_flow_actions.go` (flowActionGates, flowGates), `version_gates_workflow_shapes.go` (workflowShapeGates, statementTypeGate), `version_gates_documents.go` (documentTypeGates), `version_gates.go` (typeGate.properties, viewEntityGate, statementCaseGates + documentGates); tests `version_gates_flow_actions_1811_test.go`, `version_gates_workflow_shapes_1811_test.go`, `version_gates_documents_1811_test.go`, `version_gates_coverage_1811_test.go` (TestTypeGates_CoverEveryWrittenType), the property-aware pin in `version_gates_workflow_actions_1787_test.go`; `sdk/versions/mendix-9|10|11.yaml`
insight: **Measure the write's floor, don't read it off the type.** A shape's floor is the latest of the types AND the properties it writes a value to, and the properties usually decide: Workflows$Parameter is 9.6 but its Name is 9.18, a user task's types are 9.0.2-9.11 but UserTaskOutcome.Value is 9.19, a database query's type is 9.22 but its QueryType is 10.12, every REST operation's Method is 10.4. The cheap oracle needs no old mxbuild: copy a 9.24.30 app.mpr, `update _MetaData set _ProductVersion='X'` (sqlite3), and `exec --no-check --continue-on-error` a probe script with the unfixed build — the gate and the write read only that field, so each refusal is the write's floor at X (stored 9.24 content rewritten wholesale shows up as artifacts, e.g. Settings$JarDeploymentSettings; create module and create entity are themselves refused below 9.12 and 9.3, so probe in the stored MyFirstModule over System entities). typeGate.properties pins those floors via canon.PropertyDeclared. **Make the sweep a test, not a list**: TestTypeGates_CoverEveryWrittenType scans the write paths for `"Module$Type"` literals and modelsdk/gen constructors (resolved through each package's `init…()` SetTypeName) and fails for a written type above 9.0.0 that no type gate names, no broader gate covers at or above its floor, and typeCoverageExceptions does not explain (lowered / unreachable / RESIDUAL); stale entries fail too. Its first run found the view entity gap and five database connector types nothing listed. **Do not read `mx check` 0 errors as the platform accepting a newer property**: on 9.24.30 a database connection with ConnectionInput and a page with Variables both check clean, because mxbuild tolerates undeclared properties (propertyfloor.go); only a newer TYPE in a known property fails to load. The SDK and the platform agreed wherever a type could be measured on 9.24.30 (business events and execute database query load, as their 9.24 floors say; send rest request loads with CE7053 but its 10.1 service cannot exist). Residuals no statement-level gate can decide, left to the write: design-property kinds (theme), external entity source kinds ($metadata), a send rest request argument that is not a path parameter, and module creation (auto-create; below 9.12 the ModuleSettings.ProtectedModuleType property refuses every create module, an out-of-scope property-floor gap, as is create entity's ExportLevel below 9.3). Measured with bug-tests 1811-*.mdl: 9.24.30 before, check -p clean and exec refused the database connection at write time, with --continue-on-error each 10.x statement refused; after, MDL-VERSION01 for each, App.mpr byte-identical, the 9.x-floor statements write and mx check 0 errors; 10.24.24 the same for the 11.x shapes, and the 10.x script writes with mx check 0 errors. Controls: flowGates/workflowShapeGatesOf/documentGates stubbed fail 205/13/25 below-floor cases; a row moved below its floor fails the pin; a new `newElem("ChangeDataCapture$Version")` or a removed exception fails the coverage test; rest_client_basic moved to 10.0 fails it as a broader gate below its types.
